drained.description:
Drained reports that a derived group currently has no members, which is
what starts its expiry clock. Absent when the read path did not resolve
membership, so a client can tell "populated" from "not resolved".

projected_deletion_at.description:
ProjectedDeletionAt is when reconciliation will delete a drained derived
group. It is accurate only while the reconciler is actually running: a
paused or unelected leader freezes the clock, and this field cannot say so.

transitive_member_count.description:
TransitiveMemberCount is the number of distinct users in the group,
directly or through a nested subgroup. Inactive users (SCIM
active=false) are counted.

transitive_service_account_count.description:
TransitiveServiceAccountCount is the number of distinct service accounts
in the group, directly or through a nested subgroup. Deprovisioned
accounts are not counted; suspended ones are.

code.description:
Code is the specific machine-readable reason within Type. Optional: a
message-only error omits it.

message.description: Message is the human-readable description, safe to show to the caller.

type.description:
Type is the broad class of the error. Optional: a message-only error
omits it.
